# SQL Patterns: mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live

## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition Filters
- `grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')` — daily scope (most common)
- `grass_date = '${BIZ_DT}'` or `dt = '${YTD}'` — legacy partition key variants
- `h = ${BIZ_HOUR}` — hourly scope
- `grass_region = upper('${region}')` — single region filter
- `grass_region IN ('ID','SG','MY','TH','PH','TW','VN')` — standard 7-region scope (excl BR)

### Business Filters
- `entrance IN (1, 3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11)` — standard algo monitoring entrance scope
- `pricing_type IN (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)` — Product Ads bidding types
- `NOT (sub_entrance IN (310103) AND entrance = 3)` — DD sub-entrance exclusion
- `placement != 9` or `placement NOT IN (9)` — exclude Display/Brand ads
- `placement = 9` — Brand Tracking / Display ads only
- `placement NOT IN (3327, 3328, 33, 3337, 3338, 3339, 3342, 3348)` — exclude Livestream placements
- `pricing_type != 29` — exclude special pricing type from take rate
- `ads_id > 0` — valid ad filter
- `click > 0` / `raw_click > 0` / `deduplicated_click > 0` — click event filters
- `impression > 0` — impression event filter
- `order > 0` / `broad_gmv > 0` — conversion event filters
- `user_id > 0` — valid user filter
- `cost IS NULL` — events without deduction (used in OA backfill for CPM deduction merge)

### Timezone Alignment
- `DATE(from_unixtime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) >= DATE('${grass_date}')` — local timezone alignment (common for regional/local tz_type queries)
- `DATE(from_unixtime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) < DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)` — upper bound

## Common JOIN Patterns

### With Dimension Tables
```sql
-- Join with placement-to-business-type mapping
LEFT JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dim_placement_business__reg_daily_s0_live t2
ON t1.placement = t2.placement_id

-- Join with entry point mapping
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_entry_point_mapping_v2 d
ON a.entrance = d.entrance

-- Join with product type mapping
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_product_type_mapping__reg_s0_live c
ON a.placement = c.placement AND a.pricing_type = c.pricing_type

-- Join with exchange rate
LEFT JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live b
ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region

-- Join with display ads dimension
LEFT JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
ON a.ads_id = d.ads_id AND a.grass_region = d.grass_region

-- Join with advertise dimension
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live d
ON t.ads_id = d.ads_id
```

### Self-Join (Conversion Attribution)
```sql
-- Click-to-conversion join within 1-hour window
SELECT c.request_id, c.user_id, c.item_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_timestamp - click_timestamp < 3600 THEN COALESCE(broad_gmv, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS broad_order_gmv
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE (grass_date = '${current_date}' AND h = ${hour})
   OR (grass_date = '${prev_date}' AND h = ${prev_hour})
GROUP BY request_id, user_id, item_id
```

## Common Aggregations

### Basic Metrics Aggregation
```sql
-- Impression/Click/Order aggregation (for dws tables)
SELECT ads_id, shop_id, item_id, placement,
    SUM(impression) AS impression_cnt,
    SUM(click) AS click_cnt,
    SUM(order) AS order_cnt
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
GROUP BY ads_id, shop_id, item_id, placement
```

### Take Rate Metrics
```sql
-- Click with OCPM logic
SUM(CASE
    WHEN ctx_item_type = 2 AND COALESCE(is_preselected_vmodel, false) != true THEN 0
    WHEN is_ocpm = true THEN COALESCE(deduplicated_click, 0)
    ELSE COALESCE(click, 0)
END) AS ads_click

-- Impression with virtual model exclusion
SUM(CASE
    WHEN ctx_item_type = 2 AND COALESCE(is_preselected_vmodel, false) != true THEN 0
    ELSE IFNULL(impression, 0)
END) AS ads_imp

-- GMV conversion (raw value / 100000 for local currency)
SUM(IFNULL(order_gmv, 0) / 100000.0) AS ads_gmv
SUM(IFNULL(broad_gmv, 0) / 100000.0) AS broad_order_gmv
SUM(cost / 100000) AS expenditure_amt
```

### Brand Tracking Aggregation
```sql
SELECT ads_id, slot_id,
    SUM(impression) AS impression_cnt,
    SUM(non_fraud_click) AS click_cnt,
    MAX(cpm) AS cpm_local
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE placement = 9
GROUP BY ads_id, slot_id
```

### Algo Feature Extraction
```sql
-- Query-item conversion tuples (for feature sequences)
SELECT query, item_id, shop_id,
    COALESCE(CAST(ELEMENT_AT(global_cat_ids, 1) AS BIGINT), -1) AS item_l1_category_id,
    MAX(timestamp) AS last_event_timestamp,
    COUNT(1) AS tuple_order_event_cnt
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE entrance = 1 AND pricing_type IN (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)
    AND COALESCE(`order`, 0) > 0 AND query IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY grass_region, query, item_id, shop_id, ...
```

### UDF Decoding Pattern
```sql
-- Decode bid_rerank_trace for algo features
SELECT *,
    bid_info_decode_fuc(bid_rerank_trace) AS decoded_bid
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
-- Then extract via get_json_object:
CAST(get_json_object(decoded_bid, '$.roi3_traffic_bucket') AS BIGINT)
CAST(get_json_object(decoded_bid, '$.uplift_model_score_str') AS STRING)
CAST(get_json_object(decoded_bid, '$.pgmv') AS DOUBLE)
CAST(get_json_object(decoded_bid, '$.voucher_price') AS BIGINT)
CAST(get_json_object(decoded_bid, '$.direct_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE)
```

### 1. DWD Performance Table Production (hourly)
```sql
-- Source: workflows/data_warehouse/dwd/dwd_advertise_preformance_hi__reg_s0_live
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dwd_advertise_preformance_hi__reg_s0_live PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date, h, biz_type)
SELECT ads_id,
    broad_gmv / 100000 AS broad_order_gmv_amt,

    cost / 100000 AS expenditure_amt,

    ...

ON placement = placement_id
```

### 2. Daily Ads Stats Aggregation
```sql
-- Source: workflows/data_warehouse/dws/dws_advertise_ads_stats_1d__reg_s0_live
SELECT country, ads_id, shop_id, item_id, placement,
    SUM(impression) AS impression_cnt,
    SUM(click) AS click_cnt,
    SUM(order) AS order_cnt
FROM mkplpaidads_data.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE dt = '${YTD}'
LEFT JOIN dim_placement_business ON placement = placement_id
GROUP BY country, ads_id, shop_id, item_id, placement, biz_type
```

### 3. Take Rate (Ads Revenue vs GMV)
```sql
-- Source: workflows/data_warehouse/ads/take_rate/ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
SELECT grass_region, shop_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ctx_item_type = 2 AND NOT is_preselected_vmodel THEN 0
         WHEN is_ocpm THEN deduplicated_click ELSE click END) AS ads_click,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ctx_item_type = 2 AND NOT is_preselected_vmodel THEN 0
         ELSE impression END) AS ads_imp,
    SUM(order_gmv / 100000.0) AS ads_gmv
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
    AND grass_date >= DATE('${grass_date}')
    AND DATE(from_unixtime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) >= DATE('${grass_date}')
    AND ads_id > 0 AND placement != 9 AND pricing_type != 29
GROUP BY grass_region, shop_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement
```

### 4. Brand Tracking Display Ads
```sql
-- Source: workflows/data_warehouse/dws/dws_brand_tracking_ads_1d__reg_s0_live
SELECT ads_id, slot_id,
    SUM(impression) AS impression_cnt,
    SUM(non_fraud_click) AS click_cnt,
    MAX(cpm) AS cpm_local
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${date}') AND placement = 9 AND grass_region = '${region}'

```

```sql
-- Source: workflows/ads_algo/model/feature_producer/query_feature_increment
SELECT TRIM(query) AS query, item_id, shop_id,
    COALESCE(CAST(ELEMENT_AT(global_cat_ids, 1) AS BIGINT), -1) AS item_l1_category_id,
    MAX(timestamp) AS last_event_timestamp,
    COUNT(1) AS tuple_order_event_cnt
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = DATE '${date}' AND h = ${hour}
    AND entrance = 1 AND pricing_type IN (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)
    AND COALESCE(`order`, 0) > 0 AND query IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(query) != ''
GROUP BY grass_region, query, item_id, shop_id, ...
```

### 7. Display Ads Performance (User-level Attribution)
```sql
-- Source: workflows/data_warehouse/dws/dws_display_ads_performance_di__reg_s0_live
SELECT c.grass_date, c.grass_region, c.user_id, c.timestamp AS ts, a.campaign_id
FROM ads a
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live c
ON a.ads_id = c.ads_id AND a.grass_region = c.grass_region
WHERE c.raw_click > 0 AND user_id > 0
    AND DATE(from_unixtime(c.timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) >= DATE('${start}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
```

### Dual Schema Note
This table exists under two database schemas with different partition conventions:
- **`mkplpaidads_data`**: partitioned by `grass_region, dt, h` (legacy, Parquet at `ads_report_ng_event` path)
- **`mp_paidads`** (preferred): partitioned by `grass_region, grass_date, h` (current, Parquet at `ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live` path)

Views are created to bridge the two schemas:
- `studio_tasks/mkplpaidads_data/workflows/data_warehouse/ods/create_view_for_mp_paidads_tables`

## Derived Metrics

| Metric | Formula | Source |
|--------|---------|--------|
| expenditure_amt (local currency) | `cost / 100000` | dwd_advertise_preformance_hi |
| ads_gmv (local currency) | `order_gmv / 100000` | take_rate |
| broad_order_gmv (local currency) | `broad_gmv / 100000` | take_rate |
| ads_gmv_usd | `order_gmv / 100000 / exchange_rate` | take_rate |
| broad_order_gmv_usd | `broad_gmv / 100000 / exchange_rate` | take_rate |
| cpm_usd | `cpm / 100000 / exchange_rate` | brand_tracking |
| expense_amt_local | `cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000` | brand_tracking |
| ads_click (OCPM-aware) | `CASE WHEN is_ocpm THEN deduplicated_click ELSE click END` (excl ctx_item_type=2 non-preselected) | take_rate |
| ads_imp (VM-excluded) | `CASE WHEN ctx_item_type=2 AND NOT preselected THEN 0 ELSE impression END` | take_rate |
| discount_ratio | `voucher_price / item_price` (from decoded bid_rerank_trace) | uplift model |
